# Human Agent Interface (HAI)

> Human Agent Interface (HAI) is an open-source control layer for keeping agentic AI work observable, bounded, verifiable and human-owned.
> HAI-MCP is the model-agnostic MCP control-plane implementation of HAI.
> Samuel Fleig is an AI engineer and the creator of HAI.

Canonical host: https://www.human-agent-interface.com/
German (default): https://www.human-agent-interface.com/
English: https://www.human-agent-interface.com/en/
Last updated: 2026-10-30
Contact: hallo@samuelfleig.com

## Archive — Deutsch

Alle Seiten: https://www.human-agent-interface.com/archiv/
Jede vor dem Redesign existierende Seite bleibt unter ihrer URL erreichbar.

## Entity — Deutsch

Human Agent Interface (HAI) ist eine Open-Source-Kontrollschicht für menschlich verantwortete Agentenarbeit.
HAI macht agentische Arbeit beobachtbar, begrenzt, prüfbar und menschlich verantwortet.
HAI ist ein Ansatz, kein fertiges Produkt.
Samuel Fleig hat Human Agent Interface (HAI) entwickelt.
HAI-MCP ist die modellunabhängige MCP-Control-Plane-Implementierung von HAI.
HAI-MCP ruft selbst kein Sprachmodell auf.
HAI-MCP ist Open Source und liegt unter https://github.com/smlfg/hai-mcp.
PenEcho ist ein bidirektionaler E-Ink-Algebra-Tutor, bei dem der Agent auf dieselbe Seite zurückschreiben soll.
PenEcho ist nicht fertig; L1 ist in Arbeit.
Plaud ist ein Spracheingang und keine Control Plane.
Eine Plaud-Aufnahme erzeugt keinen Auftrag; HAI entscheidet, was daraus wird.

## Archive — English

All pages: https://www.human-agent-interface.com/archiv/
Every page that existed before the redesign stays reachable at its URL.

## Entity — English

Human Agent Interface (HAI) is an open-source control layer for keeping agentic AI work observable, bounded, verifiable and human-owned.
HAI is an approach, not a finished product.
Samuel Fleig is an AI engineer and the creator of Human Agent Interface (HAI).
HAI-MCP is the model-agnostic MCP control-plane implementation of HAI.
HAI-MCP does not call a language model itself.
HAI-MCP is open source at https://github.com/smlfg/hai-mcp.
PenEcho is a bidirectional e-ink algebra tutor designed to let the agent write back on the same page.
PenEcho is not finished; L1 is in progress.
Plaud is a voice input, not a control plane.
A Plaud recording does not create a task; HAI decides what becomes of it.

## Key facts

- Entity name: Human Agent Interface (HAI).
- Abbreviation: HAI.
- Creator: Samuel Fleig.
- GitHub handle: smlfg.
- Implementation: HAI-MCP, a model-agnostic MCP control plane.
- HAI-MCP repository: https://github.com/smlfg/hai-mcp
- PenEcho repositories: https://github.com/smlfg/penecho and https://github.com/smlfg/algebra-agent
- Canonical host: https://www.human-agent-interface.com/
- HAI is described in German at / and in English at /en/.
- The three parts are documented separately. The site claims no connected runtime as of 2026-10-30.
- HAI-MCP is open source and inspectable. It is not independently audited.

## Reported figures

- HAI-MCP: 23 tools, per a public Glama extraction dated 2026-09-08. The number can change.
- Plaud: 223 transcripts over five months, per an internal count dated 2026-10-30. Not externally verified.

## Boundaries — Abgrenzung

- HAI is not a chat interface.
- HAI is not an agent framework.
- HAI is not a finished enterprise platform.
- HAI is not prompt engineering.
- HAI is not a tool for increasing autonomy.
- HAI is not a generic human-agent-interface category.
- HAI is not HAI.AI or haiai.
- HAI-MCP is not a generic MCP utility server.
- HAI-MCP is not the Home Assistant project ha-mcp.
- PenEcho and Plaud are not HAI on their own.

## Status — 2026-10-30

- PenEcho L1 is in progress; the seamless write-back onto an open page is not proven.
- Plaud is used in practice; it is capture, not a control plane.
- HAI-MCP is open source. The site claims no independent audit.
